name: GET /api/speech/certification-runs/:run_id - One of this tenant's certification runs
description: Tenant route (Bearer JWT). Poll a run until status is completed (passed true/false, metrics) or error. A catalog entry is certified only after its certification run passes the thresholds (c1171be1-c7ce-4c6d-acbc-98ffe825bc53#AC2): llm — tool-call accuracy, p95 time to first token, barge-in stop; stt — word error rate of phone-band (8 kHz) audio a reference TTS synthesised, and time to the final transcript; tts — time to first audio, real-time factor, intelligibility through a reference STT. Keys come from the tenant key vault; ProjexCloud holds none. An operator can no longer set certified by PATCH (409 CertificationRequiresRun). 200 { run }. Errors: unknown run or another tenant's 404; no token 401. The fixture chain never starts a runnable run (see POST .../certification-runs), so the runner reaches 404.
